messages:
maria: incident-bot failed to page oncall for prod-cluster alerts starting ~08:22 UTC. Getting 403/invalid-signature from pager webhook :eyes:
incident-bot: deliver failed: 403 signature_mismatch for request_id=abcd1234 attempt=1 :warning:
jamie: I see a spike of unresolved alerts in the alert dashboard. Customers reporting slower responses on /v1/generate.
rahul: checking pagerbridge logs now. seeing `signature verification failed` and also a bunch of `timestamp out of range` errors. possible clock skew?
oncall-l1: I didn't get any pages for the SLO pages at 08:22, only Slack messages. Manual page from me to oncall went through.
maria: ok manual paging for P0s engaged. Jamie can you coordinate live mitigation?
jamie: on it. rahul, can you tail the incoming webhook endpoint on the paging side? `kubectl logs -f pagerbridge-0 -n notify`
rahul: tailing. logs: `POST /hook 403 12ms - reason=signature_mismatch header=x-pager-signature: sha256=...`
rahul: also a few `403 timestamp older than 5m` entries. NTP on the pagerbridge pod reports drift ~4m30s.
maria: that matches the timestamp error. Did we rotate signing keys earlier today? I remember an automated rotation job at 03:00 UTC.
jamie: yes, the signing-rotation cron ran at 03:00 but shouldn't affect production until the next deploy. I see a deploy-bot message at 08:18 that applied `notify/pagerbridge: rev-202303`.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: pagerbridge rev-202303 -> pods restarted (8:18:42 UTC) :white_check_mark:
rahul: pods restarted, NTP didn't catch up before rotation? New pod's clock set to host time which is skewed. Signature algorithm uses timestamp window +-5m so 4m30s drift causes rejects.
maria: immediate mitigation: 1) revert to previous release to restore previous signature key + avoid new clock mismatch 2) manual paging to oncall 3) add temporary wider tolerance on signature verify (unsafe) while we stabilize. Thoughts?
jamie: prefer revert to be quick. I'll trigger rollback. rahul, run `ntpdate -u pool.ntp.org` on affected nodes as stopgap.
rahul: running ntpdate on pagerbridge nodes now. output: `adjust time server 91.189.89.199 offset 270.3`
jamie: rolling back pagerbridge to rev-202299 now. `kubectl set image deployment/pagerbridge pagerbridge=registry/redwood/pagerbridge:rev-202299 -n notify`
jamie: rollback started :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: rollback started: pagerbridge -> rev-202299 by jamie (08:31 UTC)
rahul: after ntp sync and rollback, I'm seeing signature verify success and deliver OKs. `deliver success: request_id=abcd1234 status=200 latency=38ms`
maria: good. Are pages flowing to PagerDuty now?
incident-bot: page delivered: PD-INC-9821 to team-oncall primary via pagerduty (08:33:10 UTC) :rotating_light:
jamie: confirm oncall got paged. oncall-l1?
oncall-l1: confirmed. I got the page at 08:33 and escalated to L2.
rahul: root cause: a timing/regeneration race between automated key rotation and new deploy which started pods with skewed clocks. The rotation updated the signing key in config but the pod restart led to clock drift and then signature window rejects.
maria: action items: 1) tighten rollout ordering so key rotations don't take effect until post-deploy healthcheck passes (owner: infra) 2) ensure ntp/chrony is enforced in the node image and bootstrap (owner: eng-infra) 3) add a metrics alert for signature_mismatch rate in pagerbridge (owner: eng-sre) 4) postmortem writeup (owner: maria)
jamie: putting a temporary runbook note: if pagerbridge 403 signature_mismatch then: a) check pod clock, b) ntpdate, c) rollback to previous tag, d) manual pages. Will convert to official runbook after postmortem.
maria: customer impact: ~7 customers had delayed pages for ~11m. No data loss, only paging delay and response latency for some requests. We notified affected customers via status page.
oncall-l1: thumbs up on rollback. Also request we make the signing key rotation job conditional on `post_deploy_checks: success` to avoid race.
rahul: created a quick PR to add an NTP readiness probe and bump signature tolerance in stage only: https://github.com/redwood/pagerbridge/pull/452 :arrow_right:
jamie: adding note to incident channel about mitigation steps and marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks team. I'll draft the postmortem and include timeline. Marking incident as resolved for paging automation with follow-ups assigned. :memo:
